title: Lightdash release-safety breaking change declarations
description: Append-only breaking change declarations. A declaration is active only in a Git range that adds its stable ID.

reason.description: Operator-facing explanation of what breaks and for whom.

requiredStop.description: True when operators must land on the release that consumes this declaration.

migration.description: Migration path that this declaration acknowledges. Omit for API and type breaks.

releasedIn.description: Optional documentation stamp. Activation never depends on this value.
